intro: The **Company Switcher initializer** configures the drop-in for managing multi-company contexts in B2B storefronts. Use initialization to customize how company selection is handled and enable internationalization for the company switcher interface.

langDefinitions.description: Language definitions for internationalization (i18n). Override dictionary keys for localization or branding.

CustomerCompanyInfo.description: Transforms customer company context data from GraphQL including current company ID, company name, and list of available companies. Use this to add custom fields or modify company context data structures.
